responses.analysis: I would say that my request did improve the response. The response was clear and concise and told me what I needed to know. The robot ended up going to the shelf and reported observations of the cup that was on the shelf. I used part of the clear request to help with mine and also the compatibility card. The other 2 requests were very unhelpful and did not give clear enough instructions and the last one the robot wasn't even capable of doing. I think using the word navigate and reporting before the robot inspects was the key difference. I believe this because if the is nothing to inspect when the robot reaches a destination then there is no point and it won't be able to report on the known object that is there.
